scope: Pure pre-B immutable policy metadata, bounded strict canonical codec, local original paired freezer, and remote raw commitment comparison.
behavior_boundaries: freeze validates immutable metadata only and makes no observation or pre-B time claim.
Full policy timing and candidate authenticity remain on original agentd Rule/profile/T/B chain.
baseline_id is fixed; only candidate_id, dataset, final holdout manifest and Cell estimand are late Product slots.
Pair identity/protocol provenance is supplied by the original agentd contract; no new source observation is constructed.
Declared CrossFold model/prediction hashes are fixed before B and do not themselves prove an actual future fit.
expected_commitment_bytes uses raw CrossFold V2 commitments, original role encoding and raw paired encoders only; no freezer or old plan/execution/qualification receipt seal is called or recreated.
instantiate calls the unchanged paired freeze entry with all original metrics, roles, sources, temporal rules and actual late bindings.
All prior SharedBehavior and paired-on-policy canonical domains remain unchanged; PolicyV2 uses a separate domain.
131072 bounds one policy metadata encoding only. It is not an assertion that a whole panel body or connection request budget fits.
No new dependencies, runtime authority, credentials, owner grants, production policy, observations, or promotion route are added.
source_extraction_notes: The original V1 CrossFold normalization and hash path is shared; the original receipt field construction and seal tail is byte-identical.
The original V2 role contract bytes and strict comparator are byte-identical. V2 final hash retains cross-fold-plan.v3 over original raw plan digest plus original role contract digest.
Original Product metadata validation and metric coverage normalization are shared by both original freezer and new metadata-only freeze.
Paired plan/estimand encoders now accept raw metadata in private helpers; old callers are wrappers over precisely the same field order and domains.
